Every meaningful state transition should also be observable in activity_events.
semantics.sensitivity: May contain private source interactions, render inputs, output paths, and errors.

semantics.meaning: Stable local identifier for this rendering job.
Ledger request event whose accepted tool call initiated this render job, when known.
Agent turn identifier for the complete source interaction when known.
Content catalog item that this rendering job produces or updates when one exists.
Rendering implementation selected to execute the job.

allowedValueMeanings.remotion: Render with the Remotion code-based video pipeline.

semantics.meaning: Stable template name or identifier defining the video's composition.
Current execution state of the rendering job.

allowedValueMeanings.preparing: Inputs and environment are being prepared.

semantics.meaning: Bounded job contract and identifiers needed to resolve the authoritative script and ordered sources for this render attempt.
File metadata record for the completed rendered video when successful.
Complete observable rendering error when the job fails.
UTC timestamp when the rendering job was created.
UTC timestamp when rendering preparation or execution began.
UTC timestamp when the job reached a terminal state.
UTC timestamp of the latest recorded state change.
Optional durable personal task that requested and owns this subordinate render execution.
importantRules: Deleting the task preserves the render job and clears this reference.

semantics.meaning: Durable production script whose scene plan this background render job executes, when this is a script-driven job.
Generated uniqueness guard equal to 1 while a script-linked job is active, and null after it reaches a terminal state.
semantics.format: MariaDB boolean uniqueness guard: 1 or null
importantRules: Compiler-owned generated value used to allow at most one active job per video script; applications must not write it.

semantics.meaning: Connects this video rendering job to the content item identified by content_id.
semantics.cardinality: Each video rendering job may reference zero or one content item; one referenced record may be used by many video rendering job records.
importantRules: Deleting the referenced row preserves this row and clears the reference.

semantics.meaning: Connects this video rendering job to the observable event identified by request_event_id.
semantics.cardinality: Each video rendering job may reference zero or one observable event; one referenced record may be used by many video rendering job records.
importantRules: Deleting the referenced row preserves this row and clears the reference.

semantics.meaning: Connects this video rendering job to the stored-file record identified by output_file_id.
semantics.cardinality: Each video rendering job may reference zero or one stored-file record; one referenced record may be used by many video rendering job records.
importantRules: Deleting the referenced row preserves this row and clears the reference.

semantics.meaning: Connects a background render attempt to the exact durable video script it executes.
semantics.cardinality: Each script-driven render job references zero or one script; one script may retain multiple completed or failed attempts but only one active attempt.
importantRules: Deleting a script preserves historical render-job state and clears this reference.

semantics.meaning: Connects a video rendering job to the optional personal task that requested or tracks the work.
semantics.cardinality: Each video rendering job references zero or one personal task; one task may be associated with multiple rendering jobs.
importantRules: Deleting a task preserves render-job history and clears this optional reference.

semantics.purpose: Preserves the ordered many-to-many grounding between a portable AI-video script and the completed Agent Slayer interactions explicitly selected for it.
semantics.rowMeaning: One row links one video script to one selected request event at one stable chronological source position.
importantRules: Every source must be an exact completed request event selected by the user.
source_order is chronological within one script and must not be inferred from display order.
semantics.sensitivity: Links portable content drafts to private user requests and responses.

semantics.meaning: Portable AI-video script grounded by this source association.
Exact immutable request-received ledger event selected as source evidence.
One-based chronological position of this interaction among the script's selected sources.
Connects the source association to the exact selected request-received ledger event.
semantics.cardinality: Each association references exactly one request event; one request may ground many scripts.
importantRules: A referenced request event cannot be deleted while it grounds a retained script.

semantics.meaning: Connects the source association to its portable AI-video script.
semantics.cardinality: Each association belongs to exactly one script; one script has one through eight ordered sources.
importantRules: Deleting a script deletes only its source associations, never the underlying ledger interactions.

semantics.purpose: Stores reusable, copy-ready production scripts grounded in explicitly selected Agent interactions for external generators and the built-in Agent-interface renderer.
semantics.rowMeaning: One row is one versioned portable video-script draft with a structured production plan and deterministic human-readable export.
importantRules: A script is the authoritative content-production plan; MP4 execution state belongs to linked video_jobs rows.
Creation is idempotent for the exact Agent Slayer request event recorded in created_by_event_id.
Source interactions are authoritative and are preserved separately in video_script_sources.
semantics.sensitivity: May contain private details selected from user interactions; secrets and unrelated private details must be excluded before persistence.

semantics.meaning: Stable local identifier for the portable AI-video script.
Concise human-facing title for finding and copying the production script.
Current user-facing lifecycle state of the script.

allowedValueMeanings.draft: Active script available for review and use with an external generator.
allowedValueMeanings.archived: Retained script hidden from the default active view.

semantics.meaning: Version of the structured script_json production-plan contract.
Complete structured production plan, including generator prompt, scenes, grounding references, continuity notes, and negative constraints.
Complete copy-ready Markdown production script deterministically compiled from script_json at creation time.
Exact request-received ledger event whose authorized tool execution created this script.
UTC time when the script record was created.
UTC time of the latest script lifecycle or content update.
UTC time when the script was archived; null while it remains a draft.
Monotonic optimistic-concurrency version for user-visible script changes.
Connects the script to the exact Agent Slayer request that authorized and created it.
semantics.cardinality: Each script references at most one creating request event, and uniqueness permits one script per creating request.
importantRules: Deleting the creating event preserves the script and clears this provenance reference.
